title: Jee
desc: Vasu aspires to contest in the college elections but is forced to let go because of a politician's son. However, when the latter's goons harass him, he vows to stand up for himself.

title: Gokulathil Seethai
desc: Son of a wealthy man Rishi leads a carefree lifestyle. However, his life begins to change when he meets Nila, a college student, and gradually falls in love with her.

title: Muraimaman
desc: When his eloped sister and her lover return, Sirius and his brother welcome them. Later, Sirius falls in love with his sister's daughter, Indhu.

title: Love Marriage
desc: A man and woman who deeply love each other face societal challenges and must defeat the animosity between their families to get married.

title: Sami Potta Mudichu
desc: Kadhirvelan wishes to take revenge on his uncle, who is responsible for his grandfather's death. However, he changes his mind after he meets Neelaveni, his uncle's daughter.
